# DEMONSTRATION TENDER NOTICE - ZM-DEMO-2026-001

Fictional data for an integration test. This is not a government procurement.

**Buyer:** Demonstration Health Procurement Unit, Zambia
**Subject:** Supply of ten vaccine refrigerators - synthetic demonstration
**Budget ceiling:** ZMW 480,000
**Published:** 01 October 2026
**Closing:** 29 October 2026, 10:00 CAT
**Method:** Open bidding, national

## Specifications
- The supplier SHALL deliver ten vaccine refrigerators operating at 2-8 degrees Celsius.
- The supplier SHALL provide a signed delivery schedule committing delivery within 30 days.
- The supplier SHALL provide an equipment maintenance plan identifying a local service team.

## Eligibility checklist
- [REQUIRED] Tax clearance certificate
- [REQUIRED] Company registration certificate
- [REQUIRED] Signed delivery schedule

## Evaluation criteria
| Criterion | Weight (%) | Evidence / subcriteria | Scoring method |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| Technical capability | 60 | Refrigerator specification and a maintenance plan naming the service team | Committee scores documented specification and maintenance evidence on a 0-100 scale |
| Delivery plan | 40 | Signed dated schedule committing delivery within 30 days | Committee scores documented milestones and delivery commitment on a 0-100 scale |
sourceFiles.02-bid-demo-clinic.md:
# DEMONSTRATION BID

**Bidder:** Demo Clinic Supplies
**Bid value:** ZMW 420,000
**Bid security:** ZMW 10,000 valid until 28 February 2027

Included documents: Tax clearance certificate; Company registration certificate; Signed delivery schedule.

The ten vaccine refrigerators operate at 2-8 degrees Celsius.
Our signed delivery schedule commits delivery within 30 days: dispatch on day 10, installation on day 25, and acceptance testing on day 30.
The maintenance plan names the local service team: Demo Technician One and Demo Technician Two, with quarterly preventive servicing.
All names and identifiers in this document are fictional.

**Bidder:** Demo Medical Works
**Bid value:** ZMW 450,000

Included documents: Company registration certificate.

The ten vaccine refrigerators operate at 2-8 degrees Celsius.
Delivery timing will be agreed after the award. No signed delivery schedule is included.
Maintenance support is available on request; this submission names no local service team and provides no preventive maintenance schedule.
All names and identifiers in this document are fictional.

advisory.overview: Synthetic demonstration for ten vaccine refrigerators under ZM-DEMO-2026-001. Matrix matrix_demo_001 is marked DRAFT with C-01 Technical capability and C-02 Delivery plan. Two admitted bids were compared on the same documentary basis using full bid texts. Demo Clinic Supplies evidenced specification, named maintenance team, and committed schedule. Demo Medical Works evidenced specification only, with explicit gaps on maintenance team and signed schedule.

recommendation.basis: On supplied documents alone, Demo Clinic Supplies is the strongest documented fit because it is the only bidder with supporting quotations for both C-01 specification plus named service team and C-02 signed 30-day schedule, while Demo Medical Works has only partial specification evidence and no evidenced delivery commitment. Advisory only; committee to verify DRAFT matrix status, originals, and apply its own decision process.
